title: Tiny, cute watermelon slice
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watermelon slice: semicircle, flat top, rind bottom -->
  <!-- rind outer -->
  <path d='M18 45 A32 32 0 0 0 82 45 Z' fill='#2e9e4f'/>
  <!-- rind inner lighter -->
  <path d='M24 45 A26 26 0 0 0 76 45 Z' fill='#7ed957'/>
  <!-- red flesh -->
  <path d='M28 45 A22 22 0 0 0 72 45 Z' fill='#ff3b5c'/>
  <!-- pale flesh highlight -->
  <path d='M33 45 A17 17 0 0 0 67 45 Z' fill='#ff6b85'/>
  <!-- seeds -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='2.2' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1d2e' transform='rotate(-15 42 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='55' rx='2.2' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1d2e' transform='rotate(15 58 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='2.2' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1d2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='2.2' ry='3.4' fill='#3a1d2e'/>
  <!-- face on the slice: cute eyes and blush -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#2a1220'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#2a1220'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='47.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='47.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M47 53 Q50 56 53 53' fill='none' stroke='#2a1220' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#ff9bb0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#ff9bb0'/>
</svg>
